info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Case Root Cause Analysis Reviews API
info.description: The Case Root Cause Analysis Reviews API facilitates the submission of reviews related to banking service cases. This API allows users to provide feedback, insights, or evaluations based on their experiences with specific cases identified by 'param1'. It is primarily used by customer service representatives and case managers seeking to enhance service quality and address root causes of issues. By leveraging this API, organizations aim to streamline case management processes and improve customer satisfaction through detailed review submissions.

post.summary: Create a review for the case root cause analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a review associated with the case root cause analysis identified by RES-100045. By submitting this review, you provide feedback or information that can assist in evaluating the analysis outcomes.
